map: fix layer memory leaks

The onElevationChange being a non-suspend val caused it to be wrapped in a suspend wrapper when subscribing/unsubscribing which made it so the references no longer matched. Converting to a suspend method fixes this.

That also exposed an issue where the bitmap loader was not being cleared on pause, leading to the fragment remaining with a reference (drawer).

The MapToolLayerManager change unregisters the click listener on pause to free that reference when not needed.

These were discovered in my automated QA review while measuring memory usage of the tiles changes.
